title: Orbital Geometry
description: Implement a basic raymarching engine to render a 3D-shaded sphere. The sphere should have diffuse lighting and a specular highlight.
hintText: This is a full raymarching pipeline. You need a camera setup (ro, rd), a scene SDF (sphere), a marching loop, and a normal calculation function (finite difference). Once you find a hit, use dot(normal, light_dir) for basic shading.
